dialogues.jp: 脳みそが気だるくて、気持ちいい。

周囲の楽しげな声が、もやとなって身体を包み
込み、妙な安心感を与えてくれる。
dialogues.en:
All around me, I could hear a cheerful voice, wrapped around
my body, giving me a sense of security.
dialogues.text:
All around me, I could hear a cheerful voice, wrapped around
my body, giving me a sense of security.

dialogues.jp:
なんだか夢見心地で……でも、夢じゃなくて……
ただ、闇が広がっているだけ……。
dialogues.en:
It's like being in the middle of a dream... but it's not a
dream... The darkness slowly spreaded further...
dialogues.text:
It's like being in the middle of a dream... but it's not a
dream... The darkness slowly spreaded further...

dialogues.jp:
意識に｛もや／靄｝がかかったような、｛うつ／虚｝ろで、｛うろん／胡乱｝とし
た、微妙で絶妙な、あっちとこっちを行ったり
来たりする、そんな感覚。
dialogues.en:
My brain fell into a haze, and little by little, I felt like
I was travelling to some place far in the distance...
dialogues.text:
My brain fell into a haze, and little by little, I felt like
I was travelling to some place far in the distance...
